subject: Finalize signing sequence & witness routing for Novacorp MSA + Order Form
messages:
From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@novacorp.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Novacorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novacorp MSA/Order Form — signing logistics & witness requirements

Hi Rafael,

We received Redwood's latest redline (attached: MSA_Novacorp_Redlines_v3.docx) and the final Order Form (attached). Legal has cleared the substantive redlines; procurement needs to finalize logistics for signature. Two quick asks so we can schedule:

1) Signer authority — can you confirm Redwood's signing party and whether you need a specific countersign order? We will be signing on behalf of Novacorp as follows:
   - Julien Moreau, CFO (primary signer)
   - Elise Tremblay, CEO (secondary signer)

2) Witness / notarization — Julien will require notarization for the CFO signature because part of the entity is registered in Quebec. Can Redwood accommodate either:
   - an in-person notarization step (Novacorp to notarize locally, scan and upload a notarized PDF), or
   - allow a witness field in the DocuSign envelope and accept the scanned notarized PDF as evidence?

We would prefer a single DocuSign envelope with sequential signing (Julien then Elise) and then Redwood countersigns. Also please confirm how final clean copies will be delivered (DocuSign completed PDF + S3 link or signed PDFs).

Attachments: MSA_Novacorp_Redlines_v3.docx (redlines), OrderForm_Novacorp_Final.pdf

Thanks — if you can outline the envelope sequence and what authority docs you need from us, we can finalize timing.

Amanda
Amanda Li
Senior Contracts Manager
Novacorp

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@novacorp.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novacorp MSA/Order Form — signing logistics & witness requirements

Amanda — thanks for the clear note. High level we can support both workflows but want to lock the sequence and required evidence before sending. Proposed plan below:

Proposed envelope sequence (DocuSign):
- Envelope A (sequential): Novacorp CFO (Julien Moreau) -> Novacorp CEO (Elise Tremblay) -- include optional witness fields next to Julien's signature
- Envelope B (manual/countersign): Redwood signer (Rafael Mendes) countersigns after Novacorp completes Envelope A; we'll use a countersign workflow so the MSA gets a single completion timestamped by DocuSign.

Authority and evidence we need from Novacorp before send:
- Certificate of Incumbency (electronic PDF) or equivalent
- If notarization is required for Quebec: scanned notarized PDF of Julien's signature page (we can accept post-sign upload into the envelope or you can upload to the completed envelope as supporting evidence).

Deliverables after completion:
- Completed DocuSign combined PDF (signed & time-stamped)
- Clean locked PDF uploaded to our secure S3 bucket + one copy shared to your procurement inbox
- Zip of the envelope documents (attachments) for your records.

I attached a quick signing_matrix.csv that maps signers and witness/notary fields. Priyom / Laura — can you confirm if the witness + notarization approach is acceptable from Redwood's legal ops perspective and whether we should require a board resolution for authority in this case?

If Novacorp confirms signers and provides Certificate_of_Incumbency.pdf, we can schedule the send for Tue Jul 19 at 10:00 PT (two business days to queue and review).

Thanks,
Rafael
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: signing_matrix.csv (signer map)

Thanks Rafael — quick clarifications: we will provide the Certificate_of_Incumbency.pdf (attached).

Signers and details:
- Julien Moreau <julien.moreau@novacorp.com> (CFO) — will sign in Montreal and require notarization; the notary will provide a scanned stamped signature page after notarization.
- Elise Tremblay <elise.tremblay@novacorp.com> (CEO) — will sign remotely; no notarization required.

We are OK with Envelope A (Novacorp sequential), Envelope B (Redwood countersign). For the notarization: we plan to have Julien sign offline, have the notary stamp, then upload the notarized page into the DocuSign envelope as supporting evidence (we cannot do in-person DocuSign). Please confirm that approach is acceptable.

Attached: Certificate_of_Incumbency.pdf

If that's all acceptable, please go ahead and set up the envelopes and confirm the send time. Ideally we want the window Tue Jul 19 morning PT.

Amanda

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@novacorp.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novacorp MSA/Order Form — signing logistics & witness requirements

Amanda / Rafael — thanks for the thread. A few ops/legal items to lock before we send the envelope: 

1) Evidence of authority: Certificate of Incumbency is sufficient for our ops team to proceed. If legal review requests, we may also ask for a board resolution (only if the signing authority on the COI is ambiguous). The COI you attached looks OK at first pass but we'll confirm.

2) Notarization handling (Quebec): acceptable approach is to have Novacorp notarize the signature page offline and then upload the scanned notarized page into the completed DocuSign envelope as supporting evidence. We will add an internal check to the process so Redwood's countersign does not occur until the notarized PDF is present.

3) Envelope configuration we require:
   - Template ID: tpl_9f8e7d (Redwood MSA workflow)
   - Envelope A: Novacorp sequential (Julien -> Elise), include optional witness fields for Julien + a required checkbox to confirm notarization will follow if applicable.
   - Envelope B: Redwood countersign, executed only after Envelope A is complete and notarization evidence uploaded (if required).

4) Document retention / deliverables: once complete we will:
   - generate consolidated DocuSign PDF (time-stamped)
   - lock a clean PDF and upload to s3://redwood-completed/msas/novacorp/D-78934-NUV/ (we'll send a time-limited share link)
   - provide a zip of envelope artifacts including audit trail and uploaded notarized pages.

Amanda — please confirm the following before we schedule: final signer emails (Julien / Elise) and the expected time window for notarization upload (e.g., same day as signing or within 48 hours). Once confirmed Rafael can queue the envelope for Tue Jul 19 10:00 PT send.

Attached: authority_checklist.pdf (checklist for procurement/legal uploads)

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Legal Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Amanda — all set. Confirming the follow-ups and timeline: 

- We will send Envelope A on Tue Jul 19 at 10:00 PT exactly as proposed (sequential: Julien -> Elise).
- Julien may sign offline with the notary; Novacorp should upload the scanned notarized signature page into the completed Envelope A (we will not countersign until the notarized PDF is present).
- Template ID tpl_9f8e7d will be used; I created the envelope draft and attached the signing_matrix.csv for visibility. DocuSign link (draft envelope): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d

Post-sign delivery: once Envelope B (Redwood countersign) completes we will:
1) generate and send the combined DocuSign completed PDF to procurement@novacorp.com and upload a locked clean copy to s3://redwood-completed/msas/novacorp/D-78934-NUV/ (we will send a time-limited link).
2) attach a zip of the envelope artifacts (audit trail + any uploaded notarized pages).

Attachments included for this send: signing_matrix.csv (signer mapping), sandbox envelope draft (DocuSign link), and authority checklist previously attached by Priyom.

Amanda — please reply to confirm Julien's signing window (we'll hold send if you ask for a different time). Otherwise we'll proceed with the 10:00 PT send and will keep you posted via this thread.

Thanks,
Rafael
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
